title: Sr Associate - Frontend Development
description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-255325 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Sep. 08, 2026 CATEGORY: Information Systems
**ABOUT AMGEN**


Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


As a Frontend Developer at Amgen India, you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end design, development, and delivery of responsive, scalable, and user\-friendly web applications that support Amgen's digital, AI/ML, and GenAI initiatives.

**Role Description:**


As an Individual Contributor, you will work closely with product owners, UX designers, and backend engineers to build high\-quality React\-based applications, integrate with APIs and cloud services, and deliver secure, performant, and compliant solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in React.js, TypeScript, modern web technologies, and frontend architecture, with a passion for creating seamless user experiences and driving technical excellence across the product lifecycle.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong experience in React.js (mandatory)
* Proficiency in TypeScript
* Strong fundamentals in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (ES6\+)
* Experience with REST API integration and frontend\-backend communication
* Understanding of database concepts and backend integration
* Experience with AWS S3 integration for file upload and retrieval
* Knowledge of state management (Redux, Context API, Graph\-based state management)
* Experience with Git and version control practices
* Understanding of responsive web design and cross\-browser compatibility
* Experience with unit testing frameworks
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development practices

**Preferred Skills:**

* Exposure to Azure/AWS cloud services
* Understanding of frontend application architecture
* Experience with performance optimization and debugging
* Ability to collaborate effectively with backend and platform engineering teams

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Master's OR Bachelor's degree in IT/Computer Science/Engineering. and 4 to 7 years of work expeirence experience

**Soft Skills:**

* Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams.
* High degree of initiative and self\-motivation.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully.
* Team\-oriented, with a focus on achieving team goals.
* Strong presentation and public speaking skills.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**


Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.


We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

title: Software Engineering Lead-Java, SpringBoot, React.JS, Cloud, SQL
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Full\-Stack Leadership: Architect, develop, and maintain secure, high\-performance web applications utilizing Java (Spring Boot) and React.js
* Technical Governance: Drive code quality, technical design reviews, and engineering best practices across the full\-stack lifecycle
* AI Integration: Lead the practical integration of Generative AI capabilities (e.g., LLM APIs, semantic search, or basic RAG workflows) into existing core applications to solve business problems
* API \& Microservices Architecture: Design and optimize scalable RESTful microservices, ensuring robust data integrity and system performance
* Cloud \& DevOps Collaboration: Partner with DevOps teams to deploy containerized applications via Docker into cloud environments (Azure/AWS), supporting CI/CD automation
* Mentorship \& Delivery: Guide and mentor software engineers, break down complex requirements into technical tasks, and collaborate closely with Product Managers
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Database Knowledge: Solid experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL or MySQL, COSMOS) and familiarity with caching strategies
* Modern DevOps Workflow: Experience working with Git, Docker, and standard CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/Jenkins)
* Backend Mastery: Solid expertise in Java (7\+) and the Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data)
* Frontend Expertise: Advanced knowledge of modern React.js, TypeScript, state management (e.g., Redux/Context API), and responsive web design
* AI Awareness and Practical Exposure: Familiarity with the Generative AI landscape, including consuming OpenAI/Anthropic APIs or utilizing AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain or Spring AI)

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Basic reading/writing familiarity with Python specifically for evaluating AI prototypes
* Familiarity with Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, or pgvector)
* Experience migrating legacy systems to cloud\-native microservices architectures

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
